name: Datastore MySQL Import Tweaked
description: Applies the configured CSV delimiter to DKAN's MySQL LOAD DATA datastore importer.
project_description: Submodule of DKAN Datastore Import Tweak. It decorates DKAN's datastore import factory (dkan.datastore.service.factory.import) so that resources imported via the fast MySQL LOAD DATA path (dkan_datastore_mysql_import) use the delimiter configured in dkan_datastore_import_tweak.parser_settings. It overrides the importer class with a MysqlImport that reads the configured delimiter (falling back to a comma, and always using a literal tab for tab-separated resources) when building the LOAD DATA statement.
